title: Counts and states come from GitHub REST; search only finds candidates
why: GitHub search lags and miscounts, so a report that quotes a search total gives the owner a wrong number.
source: owner ruling 11:07 CST Nov 12 ("this is good" to option a, asked 11:05 CST), via the retrospective (session_013NEJKz5AWFJhGvmCUoi6wQ)
note: Ruled option a: a rule plus a guard. Counts and states (open, closed, merged, CI status) come from REST. Search only finds candidates by text, and each hit is confirmed with REST. Homes: a rule line in CLAUDE.md (Verification), and a guard or reply-judge item that flags a search total quoted as a count; it flags and never refuses (a reading mistake). Measure: search showed 0 PRs closed since 09:30 CST while REST showed 100 closed 10:00-11:00 CST Nov 12; the retrospective's search counts of open PRs (657, 752, 316) were wrong the same way. Note: the cloud system prompt sends sessions to `gh api search/...` for search; the rule must keep that for finding, not counting. Ready, no lane.
